name: menucloak
title: MenuCloak
description: Control MenuCloak focus, cloak, and Google Calendar settings
author: dans_huang

commands.name: set-focus
commands.title: Set Focus Text
commands.description: Set the focus shown by MenuCloak

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Toggle MenuCloak
commands.description: Show or hide the application menu cloak

commands.name: turn-on
commands.title: Turn on MenuCloak
commands.description: Cover application menus and show your focus

commands.name: open-settings
commands.title: Open MenuCloak Settings
commands.description: Edit focus text or connect Google Calendar

scripts.prepublishOnly: echo 'Use npm run publish to submit this extension to Raycast.' && exit 1
